notes.title: FREE TO PLAY
notes.content: Now that the sequel to RETROLD is being developed, I intend to set the game for free in the future, to make it more accessible and, consequently, increasing its visibility, so that more players can be aware about its existence and what is coming soon. Just wanna say thanks to everyone who supported the small project in the past :)
